connectionTimeout.title: Connection Timeout
connectionTimeout.description: The time in ms to wait before connection will time out.

disconnect.title: Disconnect
disconnect.description: Disconnect after it finish calling the producer

hostAddresses.title: Host Addresses
hostAddresses.description: Comma separated list with ip:port formatted remote transport addresses to use.

indexName.title: Index Name
indexName.description: The name of the index to act against

maxRetryTimeout.title: Max Retry Timeout
maxRetryTimeout.description: The time in ms before retry

scrollKeepAliveMs.title: Scroll Keep Alive Ms
scrollKeepAliveMs.description: Time in ms during which OpenSearch will keep search context alive

socketTimeout.title: Socket Timeout
socketTimeout.description: The timeout in ms to wait before the socket will time out.

waitForActiveShards.title: Wait For Active Shards
waitForActiveShards.description: Index creation waits for the write consistency number of shards to be available

lazyStartProducer.title: Lazy Start Producer
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

documentClass.title: Document Class
documentClass.description: The class to use when deserializing the documents.

enableSniffer.title: Enable Sniffer
enableSniffer.description: Enable automatically discover nodes from a running OpenSearch cluster. If this option is used in conjunction with Spring Boot, then it's managed by the Spring Boot configuration (see: Disable Sniffer in Spring Boot).

hostnameVerifier.title: Hostname Verifier
hostnameVerifier.description: The class to use as HostnameVerifier. By default there is no HostnameVerifier.

sniffAfterFailureDelay.title: Sniff After Failure Delay
sniffAfterFailureDelay.description: The delay of a sniff execution scheduled after a failure (in milliseconds)

snifferInterval.title: Sniffer Interval
snifferInterval.description: The interval between consecutive ordinary sniff executions in milliseconds. Will be honoured when sniffOnFailure is disabled or when there are no failures between consecutive sniff executions

certificatePath.title: Certificate Path
certificatePath.description: The certificate that can be used to access the ES Cluster. It can be loaded by default from classpath, but you can prefix with classpath:, file:, or http: to load the resource from different systems.

sslContextParameters.title: Ssl Context Parameters
sslContextParameters.description: To configure security using SSLContextParameters. When configured, this takes precedence over the certificatePath option. This allows configuring named groups, signature schemes, cipher suites, and protocols for the TLS connection.
